notesStmt.note: These lines bear only slight resemblance to the final published poem, suggesting that they constitute an early draft, likely written in the early 1880s.

These appear to be early draft lines of the poem that was eventually published as "Last of Ebb, and Daylight Waning," appearing in the "Fancies at Navesink" cluster of November Boughs (1888). The phrase "On to oblivion" appears both in this manuscript and in the poem.
